label: Gold
tooltip: Gold in the crown's chest. Taxes and tariffs fill it each fortnight; the court's upkeep and your orders empty it.

label: Grain
tooltip: Grain in the royal granaries. The harvest fills them each autumn; the realm eats from them the rest of the year.

label: People
tooltip: Everyone in the realm's towns and countryside. Levies are drawn from them.

label: Army
tooltip: How well drilled the levies are. Drills lapse without fresh levies.

label: Unrest
tooltip: How close the villages are to rioting. Tax pressure and famine raise it.

label: Legitimacy
tooltip: How firmly the court believes the crown is yours by right.

label: Contentment
tooltip: The mood of the common folk.

label: Church
tooltip: How the pulpits regard the crown.

label: Infantry
tooltip: Foot soldiers: the bulk of any host.

label: Archers
tooltip: Bowmen who thin a charge before it lands.

label: Fleet
tooltip: Warships crewed from the coast towns.
